notes.alumni-hall: 33 Third Ave: OSM has two footprints there, 'New York University Alumni Hall' (way/241844938) and 'NYU Alumni Hall' (way/405101628); pinned to the first.
notes.washington-square-village: OSM has Washington Square Village as four buildings, 1-4 Washington Square Village (way/248234598, 248234587, 248234597, 248234599) on the superblock between Bleecker and W Houston; pinned to 1 Washington Square Village.
notes.second-street: 1 East 2nd Street: OSM address node/10224157721 (Nominatim); the building has no name in OSM.
notes.sixth-street: 200 East 6th Street: OSM address node/9659538023 (Nominatim); the building has no name in OSM.
notes.washington-square-arch: A monument in Washington Square Park, not a building with classes.
notes.judson-memorial-church: A church (not NYU), no classes or meals.

detours.why: Washington Square Village's buildings and private central garden fill the superblock, so the walk leaves by the building's own path to the street and goes round.
